title: Portfolio-Size Constraints on Default Correlation: Exact Coherence Tests and Sharp Asymptotic Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2611.18759v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An absorbing default process imposes joint restrictions on cumulative default distributions across horizons. We characterize these restrictions for finite homogeneous portfolios. For binomial mixtures whose mixing distribution functions cross at most once, stochastic ordering of the entire default count is equivalent to two inequalities: the probability of no defaults must be nonincreasing and the probability of all defaults must be nondecreasing. In the one-factor Gaussian model, these inequalities give an exact interval of admissible later correlations, obtained from two scalar equations. The intervals are nested as portfolio size increases. tldr: 本文刻画了吸收违约过程对有限同质组合累积违约分布的联合约束，证明当混合分布函数至多单次交叉时，违约计数的随机序等价于“零违约概率非增且全违约概率非减”两个不等式，并据此在单因子高斯模型中通过两个标量方程求得可行的后期违约相关系数的精确区间，该区间随组合规模增大而嵌套且具有尖锐的渐近界。
en_tdlr: For binomial mixtures whose mixing distribution crosses at most once, stochastic ordering of the entire default count reduces to two inequalities (nonincreasing probability of no defaults and nondecreasing probability of all defaults), which yield exact, nested intervals of admissible later default correlations in the one-factor Gaussian model, with sharp asymptotic bounds as portfolio size grows.
